PMDG.B777.zip.Author: Fragtality

Settings.Tooltip: Automatically remove all PMDG Vehicles as they appear.
Automatically change Power Plug Type between GPU and Jetway depending on the Gate used.
Automatically toggle the Cargo Lights on the 777F when the Doors are operated or GSX becomes active.

The Plugin will set the PMDG Chocks via L-Var in Walkaround before the Plugin Connection is established.
This should prevent the GSX Menu not opening/getting Ready without Brakes or Chocks.

Trigger the SimEvent 'TOGGLE_MASTER_BATTERY_ALTERNATOR' to fix Cabin Lights (in Preparation Phase).
Only applied when on Ground and Engines not running.

PMDG.B777.zip.InstallUsageNotes:
IMPORTANT: DataBroadcast needs to be enabled in the 777_Options.ini File (for each Variant and Simulator)!
Consult the PMDG_777_MSFS_SDK Manual in the Aircraft's Documentation\SDK Folder.

RECOMMENDED: Use the internal/GSX provided Aircraft Profiles.
IF the wrong Door opens when the Jetway connects, set the preferred Door manually in the Plugin Options!
You eventually need to delete the gsx.cfg File in the SimObjects\Airplanes\PMDG 777... Folder.

NOTAMs:
• The Departure Services will start when the Flightplan is imported in the UFT
• The SmartButton is mapped to the MIC/INT Switch on the ACP (Captain and FO) - move to INT Position to trigger a Request

INI.A340.zip.Author: Fragtality

Settings.Tooltip: The Covers on the Aircraft will be removed on Session Start.
Try to fix the Airplane resetting its Fuel or Payload after GSX Services complete.

INI.A340.zip.InstallUsageNotes:
IMPORTANT: Ensure that the Aircraft Profile used is configured in the following Way (if the bundled Profiles are not installed):
• The Option 'Default Fuel System' is NOT checked!
• The Preferred Exit is set to (L)2
• Lavatory Position corrected

NOTAMS:
• Disable all GSX Options in the EFB and do NOT use 'load via GSX' in the EFB!
• Simbrief Payload NEEDS to be imported in the EFB (My Flight and Payload & Fueling -> Import all from Simbrief) before starting Departure Services
• The Departure Services are started by importing (Init Request) the Flightplan into the MCDU (with the Nav Lights being on)
• The SmartButton is mapped to the INT/RAD Switch on the ACP (Captain and FO) - move to INT Position to trigger a Request
• Engine/Pitot Covers will automatically be removed on Session Start (configurable)
• KNOWN ISSUE: GSX sometimes disconnects the Hose although Refuel is still running - the Refuel Process will continue (unless configured otherwise in the App)
• KNOWN ISSUE: The A340 likes to reset Fuel or Payload occasionally - the Plugin corrects that but you (or your Tracker!) might notice

FNX.A320.zip.Author: Fragtality

Settings.Tooltip:
The Plugin will suppress the Deboard Dialog in the EFB by setting the Flight Phase to 'Completed' when both Engines are shut down.
BUT: that also suppresses the Arrival ACARS Message. If the Option is disabled, do NOT answer the Dialog! (Or Answer it with 'Dismiss' if it should stay during Deboarding)
GPU and Chocks will be removed on Arrival while the Beacon is still on.
How long to flash the MECH Button on the ACP after the Chocks were placed.
Automatically answer the Cabin-Ready Call before Takeoff.
The Delay before the ACP Panel is reset, after the Ground Call was accepted.
Automatically answer the Cabin-Ready Call on Approach.
The Delay before the ACP Panel is reset, after the Air Call was accepted.

The Probability per Seat to 'flip' a Passenger (extra/no-show) for Randomization.
The Pax Difference is defined by the App up to its configured Limit - this Value only defines how that is applied to the Fenix.

The Interval in ms at which the EFB is checked for Changes (i.e. OFP, Equip, Payload).
Only applied on Ground - during Flight the Interval is set to 15s.

FNX.A320.zip.InstallUsageNotes:
RECOMMENDED: Use the Developer-provided Profile included with the Fenix A320.

NOTAMS:
• The Departure Services are started by importing the Flightplan in the EFB
• The SmartButton is mapped to the INT/RAD Switch on the ACP (Captain and FO) - move to INT Position to trigger a Request
• DO NOT use the 'Load Aircraft' in the EFB
• Planned Weights in the EFB can be changed before the respective Service starts

SYN.A220.zip.Author: bork

Settings.Tooltip: Engine covers will be removed on session start (MSFS24 only!).
Adds a 7 second delay between external power disconnection and removal to prevent transient faults during AC BUS 1 transfer from GPU -> APU.
Overrides Simbrief's "Passenger Weight" value and uses 175 Lbs / pax so that the pax count on the EFB matches the value in Any2GSX and GSX.

SYN.A220.zip.InstallUsageNotes:
- Request a Flightplan Uplink in the FMS to trigger departure services
- The SmartButton is mapped to the MECH CALL button on the Overhead Panel
- The aircraft cannot be fueled when cold & dark, so fuel will not be set until the aircraft has some power
